back2basics.patternId: Digital public infrastructure and AI governance
back2basics.text: Digital public infrastructure refers to technology platforms and digital tools provided by the government to facilitate services efficiently. In agriculture, such infrastructure includes digital IDs for farmers that help streamline access to government schemes, credit, insurance, and disaster relief by reducing paperwork and enabling transparency.

2026-10-26-am-d9df2daad2.deck: The Union Agriculture Ministry created 11 crore unique digital identity cards for farmers by October 23, 2026, five months ahead of schedule. This digital ID aims to simplify farmers' access to government schemes, bank credit, crop insurance, and disaster relief, reducing paperwork and delays.

Overall, the digital ID is a step towards modernizing agriculture and making it more efficient and prosperous.

back2basics.text: Cyclones are classified by wind speed into categories such as depression, cyclonic storm, severe cyclonic storm, and very severe cyclonic storm. Disaster preparedness involves issuing alerts, evacuating vulnerable populations, and mobilizing government resources to reduce damage and loss of life during such natural events.

body.label: Storm classification
body.text: The storm is classified as a very severe cyclonic storm, the second highest intensity category, with wind speeds between 118 kmph and 221 kmph.

body.label: Current wind speeds
body.text: Wind speeds are expected to reach up to 130 kmph near landfall, higher than last year's severe cyclonic storm Montha, which had 65 kmph winds at Machilipatnam.

body.label: Storm path
body.text: The storm formed over the east-central Bay of Bengal and is forecast to intensify and move northwest, making landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on October 28.

body.label: Red alerts issued
body.text: The IMD issued red alerts for 13 districts including Krishna, Bapatla, Visakhapatnam, and East and West Godavari for October 27 and 28.

body.label: Evacuation plans
body.text: People living in low-lying and vulnerable coastal areas are being evacuated to safer locations ahead of the storm's landfall.

body.label: Government directives
body.text: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu directed officials to remain alert, implement flood management plans, ensure water conservation, and keep emergency response teams ready.

body.label: Public advisories
body.text: Fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea due to strong winds and rough conditions, and toll-free numbers have been set up for emergency assistance.
